description: `x-formspec-actorscope` — one missing hyphen. Without a closed `x-formspec-` sub-namespace this typo would ride the open `^x-` seam as an unvalidated passthrough key: schema-valid, parsed by nobody, enforcing nothing, while the author believes the deployment is protected.
adrRow: §5.1 unknown `x-formspec-*` key in `extensions` → `posture-config-invalid`; the gate scans the reserved sub-namespace, and §9's schema rev closes the same key at the schema.
note: Both layers refuse, from opposite directions, and the pair is the design record. The schema closes the reserved `x-formspec-` sub-namespace so the typo cannot ride the open `^x-` seam; the branch-open gate scans the same sub-namespace (ADR 0152 §5.1) rather than looking up two exact keys, so a reserved key it cannot map fails closed as `posture-config-invalid` instead of falling back to binary admission. Scanning is what makes the gate see a misspelling of a key it never reads — the earlier exact-key lookup could not, which is why this row used to diverge.
